purpose: Question-conditioned non-language Sys1 between Sys2 and Sys0; zero-shot real grasping is a research target, not an achieved result.

hardware.gripper: parallel-jaw assumed for pilot; exact device pending

outputs: continuous top-down EEF trajectory plus gripper

data_streams.T: Goal-conditioned RGB/body/history to EEF, gripper and essential execution phase/lifecycle labels; common to all action baselines.
data_streams.B: Additional paired operation judgments: referent, constraints, evidence, progress and recovery; never supply ground-truth answers as trajectory inputs.
data_streams.G: General text/image conditional classification, dynamic candidates and evidence judgments from other scenes.

minimal_unit.scope: Single arm, tabletop opaque rigid objects, top-down grasp with yaw, goal revisions and one recovery.
minimal_unit.completion: Frozen zero-shot evaluation on target Flexiv hardware; synthetic or simulation success alone does not complete this unit.

model.query_conditioning: Questions/schema/candidate semantics encoded by backbone; task, EEF and time slot queries decode shared memory.
training_order: optional rank-16 LoRA if evidence warrants

trajectory.position: absolute xyz metres, normalized using training/predefined domain only
trajectory.gripper: physical width or explicit open/close event
trajectory.schema: eef_topdown_v1; proposed, not the synthetic prototype schema

training_proposal.optional_anchor: Same-support frozen native option distribution or trained stage-1 reference, never random head. Start lambda_K=0.
training_proposal.compute: 1–2 GPU pilot, then at most 16 A100 80GB for this plan; no training launched.

data_proposal.split_unit: source episode and asset family; hold out camera rigs and semantic combinations separately
data_proposal.teacher_privileged_state: labels only; never a G0/G1 student input

conditions.S-sim: simulation embodied data plus general data
conditions.S-mix: S-sim plus curated public real robot data; no target Flexiv task data

data_proposal.G_split_unit: Source image/document, before paraphrase and candidate generation

geometry_conditions.G0: RGB/body/history, no explicit camera intrinsics/extrinsics or calibration-derived grids
geometry_conditions.G2: G1 plus RGB-inferred geometry; future extension

simulation_proposal.fairness: Equal robot episode exposure and control labels; report extra compute and add fixed-token comparison.

core_groups: GPT-6 Astra exact snapshot to pin
real_proposal.claim: Zero-shot instance/scene transfer, not an unlearned grasp skill.
real_proposal.forbidden_tuning: No target test task/objects demonstrations, prompt tuning, threshold or checkpoint selection.
real_proposal.allowed_setup: TCP/body interface and empty workspace tests; static calibration in G1.
astra_tracks: capability budget versus wall-clock budget separately
real_proposal.sample_size: Power analysis from pilot required; 180 may be insufficient; clustered paired CI.

status.numeric_head: existing synthetic-only smoke; not a RGB policy
